cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 rejects an increment or decrement operator in an arm of the conditional operator and in the right operand of -> ("Unsupported: Pre/post increment/decrement operator within a logical expression (&&, ||, ?:, etc.)"). IEEE 1800-2023 11.4.2 allows the operators in any expression, and 11.4.7 and 11.4.11 decide when such an operand is evaluated; Icarus 13.0 and xezim 0.11.3 compile both cases.
